question: How does a student's CGPA after the first year affect continuation of a GAT/GBAT merit scholarship at GITAM?
expected_answer: The scholarship (valid only for year 1) continues at the same slab if CGPA >= 8.0; downgrades to the next lower slab (among 75/60/40/25/15%) if CGPA is 7.5-7.99 (except a 15% scholarship, which is not reduced further); and is discontinued below 7.5 -- though a student can requalify in any later year they meet the threshold again.
evidence_text: Renewal Criteria: The scholarship provided via GBAT/GAT or National/State Entrance Exams is valid only for the first academic year. To continue receiving the same scholarship in subsequent years, students must maintain a CGPA of 8.0 or higher. If a student's CGPA falls between 7.5 and 7.99, their scholarship will be reduced to the next lower category among the available slabs of 75%, 60%, 40%, 25% and 15%. However, this reduction does not apply to students who initially receive a 15% scholarship. The student will be eligible for the scholarship in the year in which they fulfil the scoring of the required CGPA in any subsequent year of study.
notes: Requires synthesizing 3+ sentences (validity period, renewal threshold, downgrade mechanism, 15% exception, requalification). Distinct from FEE-03 (combination cap, not renewal logic). This specific structure is independently corroborated by a second restatement on the same page.
